The '''White Lions''' are [[Andor]]an soldiers who have sworn fealty to the [[Lion Throne]] of Andor, as opposed to the Queen of Andor.

The White Lions were recruited by [[Rahvin]], posing as a western Andoran lord named [[Gaebril]] to replace the [[Queen's Guards]]. Rahvin had designs to claim the Lion Throne for himself, and needed the swords to achieve his goals as the Queen's Guards would have fought him to the end.

After Rahvin was destroyed by [[balefire]] wielded by [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]], and Rand himself had taken control of the city, the majority of the White Lions fled Andor and ended up near the [[Spine of the World]] with [[Cairhien]]in rebels.
